items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: He worked in that band in the palace, the Santo.

ctx.x: I think that was, it was either, either 29 or 30, Bill. Because I went up there at the latter part of 27. And I think that was, and I, I worked over this, this laundry for seven, eight months or better. And, uh, and then I went with Pettis.
Say, something I wanted to get. What was that, Stan's, the drummer's name that you talked about?
